messages:
incident-bot: Paging: SLO breach detected on cont-batch streaming path (region: eu-west-3). p99 6.2s > SLO 1.2s for /v1/stream. Affected: streaming endpoints for chat and streaming-completions. Incident severity: P1. :rotating_light:

maya: acked. I'm on call. seeing big tail spikes on cont-batch nodes, starts ~3376543180. Putting flags to triage and notify CS.

ashwin: jumping in — looking at batcher metrics. There's a sudden rise in max_batch_size and a wide seq-len variance. lots of mixed long/prompt-short combos. Scheduler fairness looks skewed toward older jobs -> starved short requests.

lina: customer-impact check: two mid-market customers reported streaming stalls and socket timeouts. CS says some users hit app-level timeouts, not 5xx but stalls. Will escalate if not mitigated in 15m.

ryan: can we temp route streaming to non-continuous path? fallback model pool available (small-llama-q4) but throughput will drop.

maya: plan: 1) apply emergency set max_batch_size=64 on cont-batcher in eu-west-3 2) enable preemptive-shedding for sequences >512 tokens 3) route overflow to fallback pool for new streams 4) scale up batcher workers by +2 nodes. Doing steps 1-3 now.

ashwin: I'm pushing a config change to the scheduler weight policy to favor low-latency jobs. Also enabling seq-length-aware packing.

deploy-bot: config-change: set max_batch_size=64 applied to cont-batcher eu-west-3 (change-id: cfg-20260315-342).

maya: applying preemptive-shedding flag...

ops-bot: traffic-shift: 12% of streaming traffic rerouted to fallback pool small-llama-q4 (route-id: route-20260315-09).

ashwin: quick note: the root cause looks like a sudden influx of mixed-length requests combined with the continuous batching optimizer packing long sequences with short ones; this amplifies tail latency because long sequences hold the KV cache & worker context. Also observed KV-eviction thrash in logs.

maya: logs snippet — paging for context:
```
2026-03-15T11:07:10Z cont-batcher[eu-west-3] WARN packer: packed batch id=89324 sizes=[24, 512, 18, 1024, 12] -> exec_time=5.1s
2026-03-15T11:07:11Z runtime WARN kvcache: evicting shard=5 entries=1200 reason=out_of_memory
```

lina: noted. CS will message the two affected customers and offer an ETA. Any ETA for full resolution?

ryan: after hotfixes we should see reduction in 5-10m. If not, fallback routing will be increased.

ashwin: additional temporary tweak: lower cont-batch pack window from 50ms -> 10ms to reduce long packing. Pushing now.

deploy-bot: config-change: pack-window-ms=10 applied (change-id: cfg-20260315-343).

maya: monitoring p95/p99 now. Initial numbers: p95 420ms, p99 1.8s (was p99 6.2s). trending down.

sre-bot: Incident created INC-5378: "eu-west-3 cont-batch streaming tail latency; routing mitigation applied". Pager escalation: infra + runtime + CS.

ashwin: follow-up items: - Investigate packing heuristics that allow 1024-token beams to be packed with sub-32-token requests. - Add weight decay to long jobs so they don't monopolize batch slots. - Improve KV cache eviction metrics & thresholds.

maya: ops note: I restarted cont-batcher pod cont-batcher-7 after config, it drained and rejoined. restart logs show normal startup.

ops-bot: autoscale triggered: +2 cont-batcher pods launched (ids: cont-batcher-9, cont-batcher-10).

lina: CS update sent at 11:18Z: "We've applied mitigations and are monitoring. You may see improved responsiveness; we will update in 30 minutes."

maya: current live numbers 11:18Z: p95 300ms, p99 1.05s, streaming stall count down 88% from peak. Continuing to monitor.

ryan: proposing longer-term: - cap individual request token budget at router tier, - seq-aware scheduling algorithm (priority to short tail-sensitive streams), - better fallback model autoscaling.

ashwin: also add an eval to our Optimize dashboard that simulates heterogenous request mixes to detect this pattern automatically.

maya: handoff to eng-runtime for root-cause and long-term fixes. On-call will follow up in morning. Incident remains open for postmortem; I'll tag owners.

sre-bot: handoff comment logged. Assigned owners: ashwin (runtime), ryan (scheduler), lina (customer comms).

maya: thanks team. Closing live mitigation phase; keeping incident open for RCA. If p99 creeps back up I'll reopen paging. :thumbsup:
